title: references/platform-readings: the tenancy census's `reach: in` is not ADR-0131 D9 admission — the #13491 ledger (PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY) decides whether a system write is stamped
body:
Shift-report item, class **platform fact** (`seat-lifecycle.md`: platform facts go to the skills lane as a `finding`, and the fix is one line in the references fact table). Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) at sign-off · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`. ⛔ Not a claim; the `domain:skills` seat triages it.

## The fact

`scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` marks a platform object `reach: in` when `resolveTenantFieldName` finds its tenant column. That is **not** admission to ADR-0131 D9's system-write derivation. D9 runs only for objects classified `tenant-scoped` in the #13491 ledger, `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` (`packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts`). An object that is `reach: in` but unclassified there makes `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` return early, so a bare system insert stores `organization_id` NULL with no refusal and no warning.

## Why it belongs in the references

It misled this seat twice in one shift, each time read from code and then corrected by measurement:
- **#23284:** `sys_notification` was `reach: in`, yet rows were NULL. The fix admitted it to the ledger (PR #23340).
- **#23256:** the seat's ruling record read `sys_user_position`'s `reach: in` as D9 coverage. The restart verification measured NULL (`6158817408`), and the lift for unclassified objects is C8's (#15212).

**Proposed line** for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`: "census `reach: in` = the tenant column is found; D9 stamping = `tenant-scoped` in `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY`; read the ledger, never the census, before claiming a system write is stamped."
